map.「Groupon Filler」按输入参数进行专业计算并输出结果。: "Groupon Filler" performs a professional calculation from the input parameters and outputs the result.
map.满 300 减 50，还差 12 元？把候选商品价格列出来，工具自动找出最优凑单: Short 12 yuan of the "spend 300, get 50 off" threshold? List the candidate product prices and the tool automatically finds the best filler combination (one or more products) and works out the smallest shortfall and the final amount paid.
map.凑单差额：录入购物车金额与门槛，算距达标还差多少。: Filler shortfall: enter the cart amount and threshold to see how much more is needed to qualify.
map.方案建议：录入候选凑单品价格，挑最小超额的凑单组合。: Scheme suggestions: enter candidate filler prices and pick the combination with the smallest overshoot.
map.教学演示：演示\"刚好达标\"比\"远超门槛\"更划算。: Classroom demo: "just reaching the threshold" beats "far exceeding it".
map.示例：购物车 268、门槛满 300 减 30，差 32 元；加 35 元商品到: Example: a cart of 268 against a "spend 300, get 30 off" threshold leaves a 32 yuan shortfall; adding a 35 yuan product gives the better deal and avoids wasteful overspending.
map.凑单值得吗？: Is filling the order worth it?
map.仅当凑单品本身需要时才划算；为凑门槛买无用物反而多花，看净收益。结果仅供电商运营: Only if you actually need the filler item; buying something useless just to reach the threshold costs more, so look at the net benefit. Results are for e-commerce operations estimates, product selection and decision reference only; they are not financial or tax advice and do not replace the latest platform rules or formal reconciliation — the platform's official rules and actual accounts prevail.
map.多档满减(满300减30/满500减60)按最高达标档计，注意是否可跨档。结果仅: With multiple tiers (spend 300 get 30 off / spend 500 get 60 off) the highest tier reached applies; check whether tiers can be combined. Results are for e-commerce operations estimates, product selection and decision reference only; they are not financial or tax advice and do not replace the latest platform rules or formal reconciliation — the platform's official rules and actual accounts prevail.
map.差额=门槛−当前金额，为负表示已达标；凑单加到刚超门槛最省。结果仅供电商运营测算: Shortfall = threshold − current amount; a negative value means the threshold is already met, and filling just past the threshold is the cheapest option. Results are for e-commerce operations estimates, product selection and decision reference only; they are not financial or tax advice and do not replace the latest platform rules or formal reconciliation — the platform's official rules and actual accounts prevail.
map.单件最优 + 两件双指针组合求最小差额: Best single item plus a two-item two-pointer combination for the smallest shortfall
map.候选价格需为可单独凑单的商品（平台部分商品不参与满减）: Candidate prices must be for products that can be added individually (some platform products are excluded from threshold offers)
map.实付 = 当前金额 + 凑单 - 优惠，折扣率越低越划算: Amount paid = current amount + filler − discount; the lower the discount rate, the better the deal
map.结果仅供参考，以电商平台结算页为准: Results are for reference only; the e-commerce platform checkout page prevails
